plugins.name: gitflow
plugins.description: A GitFlow workflow: feature/bugfix/release/hotfix start & finish, SemVer tags, default merge messages, commit identity, and the phased-publish caveat.

plugins.name: solid
plugins.description: Transversal engineering principles for any code, front or back: SOLID, simple design, clean code, code smells and complexity management — applied with judgment, not dogma.

plugins.name: pnpm
plugins.description: Package-management baseline for any Node.js work: pnpm 12 with dependency build scripts denied unless reviewed (allowBuilds), a strict 3-day minimum release age, pinned package manager and frozen lockfile in CI.

plugins.name: clean-architecture
plugins.description: Clean architecture layering with hexagonal (ports & adapters) boundaries, stack-agnostic and canon-anchored: the four layers inside each bounded context, the inward dependency rule, ports for external capabilities, and the name mapping to Evans, Uncle Bob, Microsoft and Jason Taylor.

plugins.name: clean-architecture-net
plugins.description: The .NET realization of clean architecture: one project per module with its four layer folders, internal by default with one public *Context per module, the static Add<Module>Context / Map<Module>…Context composition, the host as composition only (ProgramBuilder / ProgramApplication), the published Contracts and Query and the internal Shared kernels, and the composition test.

plugins.name: ddd
plugins.description: Tactical Domain-Driven Design, stack-agnostic and canon-anchored: ubiquitous language, aggregates, factories & hydration, value objects, validation principles, per-aggregate data accessors, domain events and domain errors.

plugins.name: ddd-net
plugins.description: The .NET realization of tactical DDD: the JorgeCostaMacia.* base types, value objects with their four factories and Convert, no coercion or defaults, aggregates (From cascades, Create seals), the exception family with fixed codes, events collected on the root, and one DbContext per aggregate as its accessor.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Testing principles and the pragmatic TDD loop, stack-agnostic and canon-anchored: done means tested, the test pyramid, one test file per unit, names as specification, AAA and independence, classicist test doubles, behavior over implementation, and rule coverage over line coverage.

plugins.name: testing-net
plugins.description: The .NET realization of the testing principles: xUnit v3 on Microsoft.Testing.Platform, test project layout and shared props, InternalsVisibleTo, naming, TestContext cancellation (xUnit1051), Testcontainers fixtures built from the repo's own scripts, test-data helpers, the clock, the host composition test, WebApplicationFactory host tests with hand-written fakes, and running the suites.

plugins.name: validation-net
plugins.description: The .NET realization of validation with FluentValidation, for anything that gets validated: one validator and one exception per validated thing, per-call validators from DI or static Create() chains, composition with Include/SetValidator, every rule evaluated (no Cascade), rule and message conventions, optional boundary validators, and use-case preconditions in Application.

plugins.name: logging
plugins.description: Application logging principles for any stack: the message as a fixed grouping key, all variable data as structured properties, the level as the outcome, correlation in every scope, a failure logged once where it is handled, and observability over log volume.

plugins.name: logging-net
plugins.description: The .NET realization of the logging principles with Serilog: GetType().Name as the message, LogContext properties (a using per property for one statement, a PushProperties helper per class for a reused set), destructured payloads, the exception first in LogError, correlation properties in every scope, the pipeline packages, and minimum levels in configuration.
